messages:
emma: Quick PR to docs: add per-request opt-out and explicit fallback_weights examples for SDK v4; also proposing 'fallback_capable' metadata in model cards. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9567

rafael: Can we include a short example showing how to force a fallback for batch processing? Some customers want to intentionally route background jobs to cheaper variants.

emma: added a 'force_fallback' flag example and a weighted fallback snippet. Paste from PR: 

```js
// force fallback for background job
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })

await client.generate({
  model: 'nebula3b@2026-08-01',
  input: 'Index corpus for semantic search',
  routing: {
    force_fallback: true, // prefer variant pool for this request
    fallback_weights: [{model: 'nebula3b-q4', weight: 1.0}]
  }
})
```

priya: Nice. Add a safety note: forcing fallback may skip KV-cache optimizations and increase cold-starts for some models. Also recommend adding `routing: { allow_fallback: true }` explicitly rather than relying on defaults.

emma: added note and short log example: `routing.fallback_used from=nebula3b to=nebula3b-q4 reason=force_fallback by_request`

ops-ci: CI check: snippet-lint ok. Link-check found one internal S3 link returning 403; marked as internal-only.

rafael: We should also add a tiny row to the model-catalog: 'fallback_capable: partial' for models where q4 variant works for short contexts but not long ones. That tri-state is clearer than yes/no.

priya: I'm wary of adding 'partial' as it complicates tooling. Instead propose boolean plus `notes` with recommended use. Example YAML in PR updated to: `fallback_capable: true` and `fallback_constraints: "short-context only; seq_ceiling: 2048"`.

emma: updated YAML. Also added a migration guide blurb on how to audit existing model cards for `fallback` metadata.

docs-bot: Running final checks on PR #9567: snippet-lint OK, YAML lint OK, internal links flagged as internal-only but present.

rafael: LGTM. Priya, any objections before merge?

priya: minor wording nit: change 'force_fallback' to 'preferred_fallback' to avoid implying absolute behavior. Otherwise LGTM.

emma: changed flag to `preferred_fallback` in code and docs. pushed.

docs-bot: Final checks passed. PR merged.

emma: backported snippet to quickstart examples and opened follow-up to sweep model-catalog for missing `fallback_constraints` entries.

rafael: thanks — I'll run the sweep and tag any cards needing seq_ceiling.

priya: closing thread. If anyone needs specific logs/screenshots for the migration guide, ping me.
